Requirements for changes in billing

  1. New optional checkbox By number of days should be added in scales nomenclature. Splitting tariff scales according to scale code subperiods before calculation should be corrected – volumes for each subperiod in tariff scales with By number of days NOT checked should be calculated according volumes in scale code subperiods, not according number of days.

  2. If billing data by profile includes more than one month it should be splitted in the way that in each split should include only data for one calendar month

Example:
Period in billing data by profile: 01.01.2024 – 10.02.2024

The system should divide it into two subperiods:

01.01.2024 – 31.01.2024

01.02.2024 – 10.02.2024

  1. The system should combine separate records for billing data by profile if they include data for the same month

Example:
Period in billing data by profile: 01.01.2024 – 10.01.2024
Period in billing data by profile: 11.01.2024 – 31.01.2024
The system should combine them in one subperiod:

01.01.2024 – 31.01.2024

  1. After calculation of the invoice the system should splits all price components which use billing data by scales according all other price components which use billing data by scales using logic for number of days. The system also should calculate old and new meter readings, but mark them with * symbol. In the splitting process the system should ignore discounts (discount should be included in the same split as the price component with which the discount is connected). For price components with discount the system should combine volumes from all rows for the period and present them as one row with Volumes, Single price and Value.

  2. For all other price components the system should not split anything.

  3. For all price components with application model Over time and level Point of Delivery should record row for each POD in detailed invoice data

  4. Calculation over time should consider billing group invocie number (1-4)

  5.  Partial invoicing new logic for profiles splitting/merging flow

  6. Discount row should be ordered after its price component for each period for each POD

  7. POD → Block for billing check

For examples, please check SubPeriodsV2.xlsx

Scales /tariff splitting

How to split tariff scales when periods are different in scale codes and also tarif scale

  • When has partial intersection

  • When scale code has gaps

  • When scale codes have intersection between each other

  • Partial splitting not valid and data will have already exact periods. if no - return an error for billing

  • Should be checked correction and override records also and if any record is invalid should ignore all records for this periods

    • Splitting dates for all scales (scale code) should be exactly the same, else error. It is possible not to have data for all sub-periods for all scales.

    • Tariff period should exactly cover whole scale sub-period (one or more), else error.

    • gaps shouldn't exist for scale codes (in all scale codes should be checked gaps, not for each scale code)

  • This validation must be done after scale correction/override flow
